easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: East Blue and the first stretch of the Grand Line. Not free points.

questions.q: Which island did Chopper join the crew on?
questions.note: A winter island with no doctors left but one very old woman.

questions.q: Who was Nami working for before she joined the crew?
questions.note: For eight years, stealing to buy her own village back.

questions.q: What is the mountain you must climb to enter the Grand Line?
questions.note: The currents run up it. Get the entry wrong and the ship is kindling.

questions.q: What device tells you the way to the next island on the Grand Line?
questions.note: It records an island's magnetism. An ordinary compass is useless out there.

questions.q: Who taught Sanji to cook?
questions.note: Red-Leg Zeff, who gave up his leg and never mentioned it.

questions.q: What promise did Zoro make to Kuina?
a: That one of them would become the world's greatest swordsman
That he would protect her village
That he would never lose again
That he would find the One Piece
questions.note: She died the next day. He carries her sword.

questions.q: Who is Vivi?
questions.note: Undercover in Baroque Works as Miss Wednesday.

questions.q: What is the whale waiting at Reverse Mountain called?
questions.note: Fifty years of waiting for a crew that never came back.

questions.q: Who is Usopp's father?
a: Yasopp, a sniper in Shanks' crew
questions.note: Which is why Shanks recognises the name instantly.

questions.q: What does Robin's Devil Fruit let her do?
a: Sprout copies of her limbs on any surface
questions.note: Hana Hana no Mi. Terrifying once she stops holding back.

questions.q: What is Brook?
a: A skeleton brought back by the Revive-Revive Fruit
questions.note: His soul took a year to find the body again, by which point it was bones.

questions.q: Who was Buggy's crewmate before he was a clown captain?
a: Shanks — they both served on Roger's ship
questions.note: Cabin boys together, which nobody believes when he says it.

questions.q: What happened to Shanks' arm?
a: A Sea King took it saving Luffy
questions.note: He called it a small price and meant it.

questions.q: What is the Straw Hats' second ship called?
questions.note: Built by Franky from Adam Wood.

questions.q: Who is Dracule Mihawk?
questions.note: And a Warlord, until the system collapsed.

questions.q: What is Luffy's grandfather famous for?
a: Being the Marine hero who cornered Gol D. Roger
questions.note: Garp the Fist, and he wanted Luffy to be a Marine.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: Skypiea, Water 7, Enies Lobby, Impel Down and Marineford.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers up to and including the war at Marineford.

questions.q: What is Ohara?
a: The island of scholars wiped out by a Buster Call
questions.note: For reading Poneglyphs. Robin was eight.

questions.q: Which animal is Rob Lucci's Devil Fruit model?
questions.note: Kaku got the giraffe, to his own disgust.

questions.q: Which division did Ace command under Whitebeard?
questions.note: He came to kill Whitebeard and stayed for four years.

questions.q: Who gets Luffy out of Impel Down at the cost of staying behind?
questions.note: He holds the gate open from the wrong side of it.

questions.q: What does Emporio Ivankov's fruit control?
questions.note: Which is how he keeps Luffy alive after Magellan's poison.

questions.q: What is Aokiji's real name?
questions.note: The admirals go by colour names on duty.

questions.q: What caused the drought that started Alabasta's rebellion?
a: Crocodile stealing the rain with Dance Powder
A Devil Fruit user in the palace
questions.note: Blame the king, wait for the country to fall into your hands.

questions.q: What is the Knock-Up Stream?
a: A current that fires ships into the sky
A storm on the Grand Line
questions.note: The only way up to Skypiea, and it is roughly as safe as it sounds.

questions.q: What was the city of gold on Skypiea originally called?
questions.note: It fell from the sea four hundred years ago, along with half of Jaya.

questions.q: Who sacrifices themselves to bring Gaara— sorry, who died to save Robin's escape at Enies Lobby?
a: Nobody — the whole crew got out
questions.note: The ship did the dying, which was worse.

questions.q: Which Straw Hat declares war on the World Government by burning its flag?
questions.note: A sniper on a rooftop, and the shot everyone remembers.

questions.q: What is Bartholomew Kuma's official title at Sabaody?
a: One of the Seven Warlords of the Sea
questions.note: And a weapon the government was already rebuilding.

questions.q: Who kills Ace at Marineford?
questions.note: Through the chest, aimed at Luffy.

questions.q: What did Blackbeard do that broke the rules of Devil Fruits?
a: He took a second one from Whitebeard
He gave his to someone else
questions.note: Nobody has explained how his body survives it.

questions.q: Who was the previous holder of the title Fleet Admiral before Akainu?
questions.note: He resigned after the war rather than serve the new order.

questions.q: What is Jinbe?
a: A former Warlord and a whale shark fish-man
questions.note: He joins the crew far, far later than most people remember.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: Wano, Egghead, and the parts the story took twenty years to admit.
hard.spoiler: Heavy spoilers, right up to the current arc.

questions.q: Which sword did Hiyori give Zoro in Wano?
questions.note: Oden's blade. It drains its wielder's Haki unless they force it not to.

questions.q: What was the name of Gol D. Roger's ship?
questions.note: Built by Tom, the fish-man who was executed for it.

questions.q: Who sits on the Empty Throne in Mariejois?
questions.note: Above the Five Elders, and unknown to the world.

questions.q: What does Jewelry Bonney's Devil Fruit do?
questions.note: Toshi Toshi no Mi, and the reason for everything she does.

questions.q: What is Luffy's Gear 5 an example of?
questions.note: Rubber applied to the world rather than the body.

questions.q: What is Trafalgar Law's full name?
questions.note: He hid the D. for most of his life.

questions.q: Who leads the Revolutionary Army?
questions.note: Luffy's father, which Luffy learns from Garp shouting it in public.

questions.q: Where was Gol D. Roger executed?
questions.note: The town where Luffy is born as a story and Roger ends as one.

questions.q: What kind of Devil Fruit is Katakuri's mochi?
questions.note: It behaves like a Logia, which is exactly why the distinction matters.

questions.q: What is Benn Beckman's role?
a: First mate of the Red-Haired Pirates
questions.note: The man Kizaru backed away from without a fight.

questions.q: What is kept in the treasure room of Mariejois?
questions.note: Seen for one panel, and the fandom has not recovered.

questions.q: What happened to Kuma before Sabaody?
a: He was converted step by step into a Pacifista
questions.note: He volunteered, and asked for one thing in return.

questions.q: Which Straw Hat was raised by mountain bandits alongside Luffy?
a: None — that was Ace and Sabo
Sabo, who is not a Straw Hat
questions.note: Dadan's hut, three brothers, one sake cup.

questions.q: What is the name of Kaido's daughter?
questions.note: Who has called himself Oden since childhood.

questions.q: What did Vegapunk broadcast to the world?
a: The truth about the Void Century and the sinking of the world
The location of the One Piece
questions.note: Recorded to play only after he died.

questions.q: How many Yonko were there when Luffy entered Wano?
a: Four: Kaido, Big Mom, Blackbeard and Shanks
questions.note: Two of them were on the same island, which had never happened before.
